sources.snippet: A compact, audio-native model that decides whether a speaker has completed their turn or is only pausing. It is designed for voice-agent endpointing where a VAD timeout alone is too eager: hesitations, fillers, code-switches, and thinking pauses should not automatically hand control to the agent.
